text_block_list.text:
Ever since New Year's, Kiseki's results 
have been skyrocketing!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-chan won another streak in the mock 
races!? Isn't she on absolute fire 
lately!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heheh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Discipline-Specific Athletic Meet, Race 8, 
Turf 2000m! In 1st place is Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —All riiiight!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kiseki, following your latest mock 
race, you've delivered solid results here 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"We got great footage, too. Maybe I can 
negotiate later to upload it to our 
UmaTube channel?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Look at this! My race video's 
getting tons of views!
choice_data_list: Oh, you're in great shape!
Oh, you're in great shape!

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her face as she proudly shows off 
the video of her victory makes me feel 
proud as well.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are surprisingly few 
comments, aren't there~? Even with this 
many views...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm overthinking it...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...K-Kiseki? Class is about to start. You 
need to put your smartphone away.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
B-But it makes no sense! This is an 
emergency! A total mystery! The video's 
view count is...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A month ago I was getting 10,000 views, 
but my latest video only has 800 
views...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The comments dropped even more... Ahhh... 
Isn't there any helpful advice written 
there...?!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki is just plain strong. She's really 
gotten consistent.” “Her winning patterns 
have become a routine, too.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is bad, this is really bad, Trainer! 
We're in huge trouble if we don't turn 
things around!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm showing the absolute worst 
tendencies! As for how bad it is... I'll 
draw a rough draft, so please take a 
look!!

Kiseki started writing out a strategy plan 
right in front of me. It looks like we're 
in quite an emergency.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with a new strategy proposal! 
Please take a look!
choice_data_list: A-Ah! I'll check!
Y-Yeah! I'll check it!

text_block_list.text:
Feasibility: perfect. Tactical 
effectiveness: perfect. As her Trainer, I 
have zero complaints.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The next one is ready too! Please check 
it over!"

Feasibility here is great. Strategic 
effectiveness is great. This is a strategy 
that could actually win in a real race...!
choice_data_list: This is...!!

text_block_list.text:
The strategies Kiseki has been sketching 
out have all had 'no flaws.' While that's 
a good thing, it also means...
choice_data_list: ...Kiseki's gotten pretty steady too, huh?

...Kiseki's become quite reliable too, 
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's totally balanced out, isn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This is fatal for a creator! Why, how 
could I suddenly—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're actually conscious of win 
rates...?!

"Win rate"—that is what an athlete 
obsessed with victory should value most of 
all. Normally, there shouldn't be any 
problem with that, but...
choice_data_list: May I ask why that's no good?
Can I ask why that won't work?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, I shall explain! 
'Stabilizing win rates' brings a 
stability-oriented mindset to your ideas!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In other words, without taking risks, 
nothing ever changes! The thrill that 
grips the readers disappears, —and only 
"boredom" remains!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
""Oh, I've seen this one too~" "Guess I'll 
skip it~" ...No! Absolutely not! Nooo! I 
won't let that happen!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We must break through right now! If it's 
for the sake of entertainment, I'm ready 
to shed tears of blood in defeat... Wait, 
the protagonist is supposed to win...!? 
Gwaaahhh?!
choice_data_list: Calm down, Kiseki!
Calm down, Kiseki!

text_block_list.text:
And so, still thoroughly bewildered, 
Kiseki began staring at her tablet. Her 
next scheduled race was—

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we would love for you to run as our 
featured runner in the next event race in 
March!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the main attraction?! Wah, 
wah-wah—Trainer!"
...I have a bad feeling about this.

And then, the day of the event race 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's Kiseki-chan~!" "Welcome to the 
Lively Festival!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Helloooo, everyone! ...Alright, alright, 
alright!

It is certainly wonderful that Kiseki is 
so highly motivated. However...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This plan will work! It definitely will!! 
Please, just let me try it once!!"

Ever since then, Kiseki's zeal has been 
running in circles, making it abnormally 
difficult to align our opinions.

Even now, she is visibly tense. I'd really 
like to help her settle her feelings at 
least once, but...
choice_data_list:
Kiseki, let's talk this over one more 
time, shall we?

Kiseki, won't we talk this over one more 
time?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "No! I'm completely fine!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And next up is a proper 1800m race 
featuring the Umamusume!! The center of 
attention is... this Umamusume, Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Besides, they already called for me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Leave it to me! I'm an Umamusume who can 
create fun!!”
And so, the strategy Kiseki chose was...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear meee!? Kiseki isn't moving up at 
all!? She's fallen even further behind at 
the fourth corner!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Is there still time for a last spurt from 
way back here!? Um, Kiseki-san!? 
Kiseki-saaaan!?

...Kiseki's strategy was to pass the 
entire pack from dead last in the final 
150 meters. It was a truly reckless plan.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki-chan, what's wrong...?” “Why did 
she do something so strange all of a 
sudden...?”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do...? When I search for 
"Kiseki"... W-W-Wah...
choice_data_list:
...Let's avoid checking the internet right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes...

Kiseki seems to have taken quite a 
beating. Rubbing her back, I think about 
what our next move should be.

"...What she wants to put on is an 
entertaining race. Winning isn't her only 
goal."

"Yet when she actually tries to capture 
that fun, the vision just doesn't come to 
her right now."

...If she continues to stray aimlessly 
like this, her spirit will wither away 
before she ever finds a clue to the 
solution.
choice_data_list: How about taking a break for once?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh, r-rest, as in—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you give me a break? If I put 
down my pen now, I'll......"

...Kiseki is an Umamusume with the mindset 
and conviction of a creator. To her, 
'resting because I can't create' might be 
entirely taboo.
choice_data_list: Sorry, no rest today then.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: Still, try not to push yourself too hard.
Still, try not to push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.text:
It is my responsibility as well for 
failing to coordinate properly with Kiseki 
and leading to this result.

...Above all else, I was the one caught up 
in the euphoria of Kiseki's victory. I was 
simply too overjoyed by her winning.

For Kiseki, creating an "exciting race" is 
just as important. —I must never forget 
that.
choice_data_list:
...Sorry. Let's give it our all again 
tomorrow.

...Sorry. Let's do our best again 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

This year is the Classic year, a crucial 
year for Kiseki.

I want to resolve this issue somehow 
before the Classic Triple Crown races come 
to an end...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Good timing. There was something I wanted 
to ask you."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—I heard your win rate has been 
remarkably high lately.”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, who are you planning to run against 
next? Has your race schedule been decided 
yet?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Cooking up another interesting strategy, 
aren't you? You always were full of 
creative ideas.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: N-No, well... that's—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Don't keep me in suspense.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I'd like you to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (――...Those are eyes full of expectation.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(They're expecting something 
'entertaining'. Ngh... from me...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: U-Um...... well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A secret...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... phew... haa......

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaahhh.........!
